title: Closeness of an Extension Request to Expiry — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
Reservations and Loyalty desk rule note on how the closeness of an extension request to expiry acts on the extension term of a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers.

**Rule.** The closeness of an extension request is the number of calendar days from the request date to the credit's expiry date as recorded on the credit. The months of the extension term, added together, are then treated as follows:
- **no more than 15 days** remain: the summed months are halved and rounded up to a whole month;
- **more than 15 but no more than 30 days** remain: the summed months are multiplied by three quarters and rounded down to a whole month;
- **more than 30 days** remain: the summed months are used as they stand.

## Days remaining and treatment

| Calendar days from the request date to the recorded expiry date | Treatment of the summed months |
|---|---|
| 0 to 15 | halved, rounded up to a whole month |
| 16 to 30 | three quarters, rounded down to a whole month |
| 31 or more | unchanged |

## Worked cases (hypothetical, summed months of 9, expiry date 30 August 2026)

| Request date | Days remaining | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 July 2026 | 31 | used as it stands | 9 months |
| 31 July 2026 | 30 | 9 multiplied by three quarters is 6.75, rounded down | 6 months |
| 14 August 2026 | 16 | 9 multiplied by three quarters is 6.75, rounded down | 6 months |
| 15 August 2026 | 15 | 9 halved is 4.5, rounded up | 5 months |
